items.name: Juhannus 2024
items.information:
Please read through the [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.
The schedule may be subject to change, so make sure to be at the venue at least 30 minutes before your scheduled events.

Lue säännöt ([englanniksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), [suomeksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/finnish/)) ennen kilpailua.
Aikataulu voi muuttua päivän aikana, joten ole paikalla vähintään 30 minuuttia ennen lajejasi.

items.name: CubingUSA Rocky Mountain Championship 2024

venue.name: [Utah Valley Convention Center](https://utahvalleycc.com/)
venue.address: 220 West Center Street, Suite 200 Provo UT, 84601

items.information:
This competition is open to all competitors, but only competitors who are residents of Arizona, Colorado, Idaho, New Mexico, Montana, Utah, and Wyoming are eligible to win the title of Rocky Mountain Champion.

Go to our [link tree](https://linktr.ee/utahcubing) to find links to our Facebook group, Instagram page, and website, as well as the Rockies Discord Server, to be notified when local competitions are announced and to keep in touch with cubers in the area!

items.name: Hilliard Hippocampus XV - Summer Solstice 2024

venue.name: Private residence
venue.address: Address will be emailed to registered competitors

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa0ZyIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--b0f79de34f74b7a5f43eff3c7dcaa5f0965315de/hilliardhippocampuswebsite.png)

This competition is on a **Thursday evening** and will only feature blindfolded events. This competition is not recommended for first-timers or for those looking for a typical competition experience. Please consider instead any of the [many other competitions happening in Ohio](https://worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list).

Only one guest per competitor is permitted. Please consider coming without a guest as spectator seating will be limited.

In honor of the summer solstice, a special prize will be given out during the awards ceremony.
